video.description:
Learn to explain how Swift runs work on queues: Grand Central Dispatch, Serial Queue & Concurrent Queue, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Grand Central Dispatch - A system library that runs your work on queues and manages the threads for you.
Serial Queue - A queue that runs one task at a time, in the order the tasks were added.
Concurrent Queue - A queue that can start several tasks at the same time without waiting for earlier ones.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.description:
Explain Grand Central Dispatch, Serial Queue & Concurrent Queue in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Grand Central Dispatch, Serial Queue, Concurrent Queue 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Grand Central Dispatch - A system library that runs your work on queues and manages the threads for you.
한국어: Grand Central Dispatch: 작업을 큐에서 실행하고 스레드 관리를 대신해 주는 시스템 라이브러리

Serial Queue - A queue that runs one task at a time, in the order the tasks were added.
한국어: Serial Queue: 한 번에 하나의 작업만, 추가된 순서대로 실행하는 큐

Concurrent Queue - A queue that can start several tasks at the same time without waiting for earlier ones.
한국어: Concurrent Queue: 앞선 작업이 끝나기를 기다리지 않고 여러 작업을 동시에 시작할 수 있는 큐

landscape.hook: Can you explain Grand Central Dispatch, Serial Queue and Concurrent Queue in English?

dialogue.title: The mixed-up logs
dialogue.setting: A log that prints in a strange order

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my log lines look mixed up. I use Grand Central Dispatch, but I am not sure how it works.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Grand Central Dispatch runs your work on queues and manages the threads for you. Which queue is `q`?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I wrote `DispatchQueue(label: "log")`, so I think it is a serial queue.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. A serial queue runs one task at a time, in the order you add them.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So the first line always prints first?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. On a serial queue the order is safe.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Then I will make `q` concurrent, because it is faster.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Wait, not so fast. A concurrent queue starts tasks together, so the order can change.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Ah, that is why my old logs were mixed up. I used one before.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a serial queue for logs, and a concurrent queue for heavy work.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good plan. Grand Central Dispatch makes both easy.
Grand Central Dispatch manages the threads for us.
